Priya: monthly recurrence check 7: top recurring themes last 30d: model-serving OOMs, IO throttles on export jobs, sporadic DNS resolver flaps. need short owners + concrete short-term mitigations.

Max: I'll own model OOMs. short plan: per-model memory caps at runtime, add OOM alert with top-k heap traces, and conservative default batch sizes. ETA: PR by Wed, canary next week.

Nina: IO throttle owner. root cause looks like concurrent export jobs + large checkpoint writes. short-term: serialize heavy exports and add per-worker backpressure. longer-term: stream writes and shard uploads. ETA: design Thurs, INF-4302 ticket after.

Luca: DNS flaps  likely from resolver TTL changes during provider failover. mitigation: enable local caching layer + exponential retry with jitter in resolver client. I'll flip a config on a single region tomorrow as a canary. ETA: Mon.

ops-bot: Tracker created: REC-2026-04. Tickets: INF-4301 (OOM safeguards), INF-4302 (export backpressure), INF-4303 (dns-cache+retry).

Priya: ACs: OOM fixed = zero OOM restarts in critical pools for 30 days; IO fixed = median export latency reduction 50% and no throttle alerts for 14 days; DNS fixed = resolver-error-rate < 0.1% for 7 days post-canary. Leah/ops: please add these ACs to REC-2026-04.

Max: ack. adding OOM alert rule and sample heap-capture script to INF-4301. snippet: 
```
# abortive capture
kubectl exec -n svc $POD -- pmap $PID > /tmp/heap.txt || true
```

Nina: adding per-route IO queue metric to INF-4302; will include a simple dashboard.

Luca: canary region config change scheduled; will ping when live.

Priya: scheduling a 15m follow-up Tue 11:00 to confirm PRs/canary. calendar invite to #incidents. reopen here if blockers.
